tunables.name: MS_PER_SECOND
tunables.reason: milliseconds in a second: a unit, not tuning

tunables.name: TICKS_PER_SECOND
tunables.reason: the sim's fixed step rate, a mirror of src/fight/sim.ts STEP = 1 / 60 (tests/units.test.ts pins the two together): an engine constant, not tuning

tunables.name: CM_PER_M
tunables.reason: centimetres in a metre: a unit, not tuning

tunables.name: TOKEN_TAG_CHARS
tunables.reason: how many trailing characters of a token a log line shows as its short tag: log formatting, not a game rule

tunables.name: SEED_LIMIT
tunables.reason: a fight seed is a positive 31-bit integer: the record format's seed width, not tuning

tunables.name: UINT32_BYTES
tunables.reason: bytes in a 32-bit word: a unit, not tuning

tunables.name: UINT32_RANGE
tunables.reason: 2^32, to turn four bytes of a hash into a fraction in [0, 1): arithmetic, not tuning

tunables.name: KILL_ID_HEX
tunables.reason: storage format: the hex characters of the sha256 kept in a kill's id (enc.<hex>), the width of that id in the events and ledgers; changing it would orphan every stored id

tunables.name: POSE_BYTES
tunables.reason: wire/storage size contract with the writer and database (body or record cap); changes only with the protocol

tunables.name: HERO_SIDE
tunables.reason: the hero is side 0 in every fight: a sim convention (the fighter index the verifier tallies events against), not a tuning number

tunables.name: MAX_BODY
tunables.reason: wire limit: the most bytes of request body the location endpoint reads (a hostile-body bound of the HTTP contract with the presence writer), not a game rule

tunables.name: ZONE_CM
tunables.reason: storage bound: the x/z columns of origins_character_location are check (between 0 and 30000) in the old town frame (migration 202610070009); the code must refuse exactly what the database refuses, so it is pinned to the migration by tests/location-bounds.test.ts, not tied to the live town size

tunables.name: STATUS
tunables.reason: the error code -> HTTP status map: the protocol numbers of the API, not a game rule

tunables.name: MAX_EVENT_ID
tunables.reason: wire / storage limit: the origins_events.event_id check's own bound, the contract with the database, not a game rule

tunables.name: MAX_RECORD_CHARS
tunables.reason: wire/storage size contract with the writer and database (body or record cap); changes only with the protocol

branchIds.reason: an API reason code of the consume endpoint (protocol vocabulary): consume burns only for a quest hand-in, the smith is apply_upgrade; a wire word, not a content id
an item-category path (categoryOf(...).path === 'gear'): the contracts taxonomy's closed category, not a row id
